RESOLUTION NO.
Date: 310/31
ENTITLED:“A RESOLUTION DIRECTING CITY STAFF TOINITIATE, DEVELOP,
AND EXECUTE A PROPERTY ASSESSED CLEAN ENERGY (PACE)
PROGRAM."
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne desires to encourage economic development and in
particular, re-development in Cheyenne; and
WHEREAS, the Wyoming Legislature has authorized the use of Property Assessed Clean
Energy (PACE) Program through Wyoming Statute  15-1-701, et. seq.; and
WHEREAS, the PACE statute permits a county, a municipality, or a joint powers board
WHEREAS, the City of Cheyenne must establish an“energy improvements program,”
which is defined as a“program authorizing energy efficiency or renewable energy improvements
in a program adopted by a municipality, county or joint powers board"; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne desires City Staff to initiate
the development of an energy improvements program; and
WHEREAS, the Governing Body agrees to provide the necessary funding for the
initiation, development, and execution of the PACE program.
NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE GOVERNING BODY OF THE
CITY OF CHEYENNE, WYOMING, that the Governing Body of the City of Cheyenne
directs City Staff to initiate, develop, and execute a Property Assessed Clean Energy Program
(PACE).
